#9250
—DNtpe DATE
SEPT 18,2024

Ordinance

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO

Section 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by the changing all of the Residential-Business
Planned Development Number 1338 symbols and indications as shown on Map No.
1-F in the area bound by:

The public alley next north of and parallel to West Huron Street; North Franklin
Avenue, West Huron Street; and North Orleans Street.

to those of a DX-5 Downtown Mixed-Use District.

Section 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage
and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 701-711 N. Orleans Street, 300-330 W. Huron Street,
and 700-710 N. Franklin Avenue, Chicago, linois.
